title: Development Projects
description: Development Projects in Sandy City, Utah. The upstream service publishes no description for this layer. 64 multipolygon features, mirrored as GeoParquet in EPSG:3566 (NAD83(HARN) / Utah Central (ftUS)) with Web Mercator vector tiles for display. See the [agent guide](AGENTS.md) for the schema, the coded-value lists and queries that run.

table:columns.name: OBJECTID
table:columns.description: Esri object identifier. A row number assigned by the source geodatabase and reassigned when the layer is republished. It is not a stable key and must not be used to join across collections or across refreshes.

table:columns.name: Project_Name
table:columns.description: Sandy City publishes no definition for this column, and the source layer declares no coded-value domain for it. Measured in the published file: Populated on 100% of 64 rows, 64 distinct values.

table:columns.name: Description
table:columns.description: Description of the feature, entered by city staff. Measured in the published file: Populated on 56% of 64 rows, 35 distinct values.

table:columns.name: Address
table:columns.description: Street address of the feature. Measured in the published file: Populated on 95% of 64 rows, 58 distinct values.

table:columns.name: Project_Type
table:columns.description: One of. The source layer's domain allows: `Subdivision Plat`, `Site Plan Review`, `Residential`, `Special Event`, `Other`.

table:columns.name: Key_Words
table:columns.description: One of. The source layer's domain allows: `Plat`, `Site Plan`, `Deed`, `Permit`, `Event`, `Project`, `Other`.

table:columns.name: Case_Number
table:columns.description: Sandy City publishes no definition for this column, and the source layer declares no coded-value domain for it. Measured in the published file: Populated on 100% of 64 rows, 64 distinct values.

table:columns.name: created_user
table:columns.description: Username of the staff member who created the row, from the geodatabase editor tracking.

table:columns.name: created_date
table:columns.description: Timestamp when the row was created, from the geodatabase editor tracking. It records the database edit, not when the feature was built in the world.

table:columns.name: last_edited_user
table:columns.description: Username of the staff member who last edited the row, from the geodatabase editor tracking.

table:columns.name: last_edited_date
table:columns.description: Timestamp when the row was last edited, from the geodatabase editor tracking. It records the database edit, not a change in the world.

table:columns.name: DocumentsLink
table:columns.description: Sandy City publishes no definition for this column, and the source layer declares no coded-value domain for it. Measured in the published file: Populated on 47% of 64 rows, 30 distinct values.

table:columns.name: Bond
table:columns.description: One of. The source layer's domain allows: `Not Calc`, `Waiting`, `Posted`, `Warranty`, `Refunded`, `N/A`.

table:columns.name: Status
table:columns.description: Operational status of the feature. See the measured values below, because the source layer declares no code list. Measured in the published file: Populated on 48% of 64 rows, 6 distinct values.

table:columns.name: Shape__Area
table:columns.description: Polygon area computed by the geodatabase, in the square units of the source coordinate system. Recompute it from the geometry rather than trusting it, because it is not updated when a shape is edited.

table:columns.name: Shape__Length
table:columns.description: Line length or polygon perimeter computed by the geodatabase, in the units of the source coordinate system. Recompute it from the geometry rather than trusting it.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Feature geometry, WKB encoded, in the collection's `proj:epsg` coordinate system.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: Per-row bounding box written by gpio, as a struct of `xmin`, `ymin`, `xmax`, `ymax`, in the same coordinate system as the geometry. Rows are in Hilbert order, so filtering on this column prunes row groups efficiently.
